documentTitle.description: Main title or heading on the PDF. If none, not_shown.

referenceNumber.description: Primary reference such as RN..., file no., case id. If none, not_shown.

partiesSummary.description: Short text listing buyer, seller, or other key parties if visible. Else not_shown.

propertyOrSubject.description: Property address, flat description, or legal subject of the document. Else not_shown.

keyAmountsText.description: Important amounts, totals, or consideration as printed (keep formatting). Else not_shown.

keyDatesText.description: Completion, settlement, or other key dates as printed. Else not_shown.

oneLineSummary.description: One concise English sentence describing what this PDF is.
